metadata.description: Comprehensive mise skill for Claude Code covering the full mise ecosystem: tasks, dev tools, environments, hooks, daemons, diagnostics, machine bootstrap, and configuration.

plugins.name: mise
plugins.description: Use when working with mise - creating or editing mise.toml, .mise.toml, mise.local.toml, or file tasks; defining tasks and their usage-spec arguments; managing dev tools, backends, and lockfiles; configuring environments, secrets, hooks, daemons, sandboxing, or settings; machine bootstrap and dotfiles; monorepo workspaces; or running any mise CLI command.
